notes.title: Version 1.0.6 patch notes
notes.content:
Version 1.0.6 of Book of Heroes is live. The main focus this time was on adding Russian as a language option and fixing issues with the existing languages.

Added
[list]
  [*] Support for Russian language
[/list]

Localization fixes
[list]
  [*] Dice rolls in tooltips etc. are now localized
  [*] Suggested character names are now localized
  [*] Henchman names are now localized
  [*] Inrah Shrine hint is now properly localized
  [*] The Long Action Bar now uses localized spell and interaction names
  [*] Fixed unlocalized "Opportunity Attack" messages in Combat Log
  [*] Fixed some spells displaying two log messages, with one incorrectly localized
  [*] Fixed various texts not updating when the game language was changed
  [*] Fixed various other untranslated texts ("Ancient Blessing", "Paused" etc.)
[/list]

Other fixes
[list]
  [*] Journal now scrolls instead of shrinking the text to unreadable sizes with long storyline texts
  [*] Fixed characters getting stuck when interrupting a long action with another long action
  [*] Fixed Klarum Purum triggering on failed check
  [*] Fixed Catch Blade 
  [*] Fixed Card Details tooltips triggering even when the details were hidden
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 is out
notes.content:
Book of Heroes version 1.0.5 is live with another batch of fixes and improvements. Thanks to everyone for the reports, suggestions and other feedback!

Added
[list]
  [*]Damage bonuses for melee weapons based on the weapon’s Primary Attribute and Damage Threshold, as per DSA 5e rules (+1 DP per Attribute Point above the Damage Threshold)
[/list]

Fixed
[list]
  [*]Fixed a broken storyline stage causing characters to fail to load
  [*]Fixed Armillary adventure exit door not always opening when it should
  [*]Shrine puzzles will no longer prevent completing the adventure
  [*]Fixed Encumbrance getting removed when a character is knocked down
  [*]Fixed Liturgical Shield giving protection on failed spell check
  [*]Fixed statues of Phex not doing what they were supposed to
  [*]Cave spiders are no longer Sentient (will not answer to provoke)
  [*]Fixed inaccessible containers in some places
  [*]Fixed crafting recipe for Gas Trap
  [*]Fixed progression card AP costs sometimes being higher than they were meant to
  [*]Fixed “regained X KP” (instead of AE) messages for mages when resting
  [*]Fixed item names overflowing in tavern UI
  [*]Fixed Raven’s Beak damage bonus vs. undead
  [*]Fixed Adersin Sword damage value
  [*]Fixed Pastilles Against Pain duration
[/list]

Improved
[list]
  [*]Revamped progression cards relating to gaining new Spells
  [*]Correct rounding when calculating Derived Characteristics (round up when fractional part is 0.5 or higher)
  [*]Balanced ingredient prices
  [*]Improved henchman behaviour after “Follow Me” toggle
  [*]Improved indicators for friendly creatures (e.g. Treants and Tree Dragons) to more clearly differentiate them from enemies
  [*]Improved usability of Lost City cogs puzzle
  [*]Improved Master Chest encounter to make it more clear how it works
  [*]Improved usability of Forest pressure plate puzzle
  [*]Loot dropped by enemies is now highlighted to make it less easy to miss
  [*]Limited Stupor from Old Soldier encounter to 1 level
  [*]Increased Quicksilver duration
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 is out (Character loading hotfix)
notes.content:
Hello all!

Version 1.0.4 is now out on Steam. The changelog this time is notably short:
[list]
  [*] Fixed characters failing to load if they had spells at spell rating 26 or higher.
[/list]

Rest assured, this is not everything we've been working on since 1.0.3, but due to the severity of the issue we wanted to get a fix out as soon as possible. More fixes and improvements are in various stages of the implementation and QA process for version 1.0.5.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is out
notes.content:
Hello!

Book of Heroes version 1.0.3 is now live with another batch of fixes and improvements. More are in the pipeline. Big thanks again to everyone for the bug reports and other feedback!

Fixes
[list]
	[*]Fixed all characters loading without hair after double-tapping Esc to skip the intro.
	[*]Fixed permanent hair loss if the hair fails to load for any reason in the future. Unfortunately, there's no way to automatically fix existing characters that were already saved with missing hair.
	[*]Fixed “Find the bandit with the amulet” personal quest only working for the Host.
	[*]Fixed Dialogue window getting stuck open between adventures.
	[*]Fixed Rest window getting stuck open between adventures.
	[*]Fixed Grey Mage henchman missing Spellcaster advantage.
	[*]Fixed henchmen attacking tameable creatures.
	[*]Fixed friendly creatures (such as Tree Dragons) preventing Rest.
	[*]Fixed double log message from Balsam Salabundle, with one of the messages broken.
	[*]Fixed roads abruptly ending at the Boronyard in Forest.
	[*]Fixed henchmen getting stuck in the pit in the “bridge over pit” room in Forest.
	[*]Fixed an unreachable “Loose Tile” in Dungeon maps.
	[*]Fixed some typos and mistakes in texts.
[/list]

Improvements
[list]
	[*]You can now spend silver to redraw basic (non-upgraded) Progression Cards at the Fortune Teller in the Tavern. E.g. redrawing a “Squire” card will replace it with another “Squire” card.
	[*]Henchmen now respond to “Help” and “Heal” requests from the Chat Wheel by attempting to stabilize or heal the player.
	[*]Henchmen respond in chat to Chat Wheel and Map Pins that they understand.
	[*]Tweaked henchman behaviour when reacting to Map Pins to make them more responsive.
	[*]Improved “Forge of Agrimoth” end puzzle (more clear indication when it’s completed, some other tweaks).
	[*]Reduced enemy Disengage frequency.
	[*]Show log message when damage is blocked by Gardianum or Liturgical Shield.
	[*]Removed “Luck” advantage from Gambler origin (no gameplay effect).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 is out
notes.content:
For the past few days, we at Random Potion have been assessing, reproducing and fixing the most acute issues discovered since launch, and are now ready to launch version 1.0.2. 

Our priority right now is in fixing bugs, and that work is still ongoing. We do also follow the discussions and reviews here on Steam, and are in active talks with the publisher to determine the best steps forward.

Thanks to everyone for the bug reports, constructive criticism and other feedback!


Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed players with certain system locales (at least Norwegian Bokmål) being unable to progress beyond the main menu.
[*] Fixed "Steam Default" language option not working. The game would always start in english, unless the "Deutsch" option was selected in the in-game options, instead of "Steam Default (Deutsch)".
[*] Downtuned "Sleepwalker" disadvantage and reduced its proc chance. It will no longer teleport you miles away from the party, behind locked doors or, in one case of a misplaced spawn point, inside walls.
[*] Show "Sleepwalker" floater on the affected character after resting finishes, to reduce confusion over the character having moved on his/her own.
[*] Fixed the game being un-quittable when the player has no characters.
[*] Reduced memory overhead from having multiple characters in your account. More work needs to be done on memory usage, but character count should no longer affect it as much.
[*] Enemy loot (such as the dungeon exit key) is now spawned at the feet of the downed enemy. This should prevent it from ending up behind locked doors or at the bottom of a lake.
[*] Regeneration is now shown in the Log while resting.
[*] Elves can now acquire spells via character progression
[*] Lower difficulty for the early adventures
[*] Cultists are not as spell happy anymore
[*] Enemies leave less traps
[*] Removed Luck advantage from new characters (it has no function in game)
[*] Henchmen finish combat before stabilising
[*] Henchmen now react to 'Trap' map marker
[*] Adventure Results screen layout fixed
[*] Fixed personal quest triggering multiple times
[*] Added tooltips to progression cards
[*] Fixed movement speed from Axxeleratus never ending
[*] Fixed “Fire And Brimstone” spell particles never ending
[*] Fixed several ESC and System Menu bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Pick your profession - part 2
notes.content:
When playing The Dark Eye: Book of Heroes you have a choice of 12 different professions – here is your chance to get to know a bit more about playing Gray mage, Knight, Mercenary, Rogue and White Mage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/ff0e27d53e4e1a74e33acc6432b99cd359b3bf8d.png[/img]
[h2]Gray mage[/h2]
The disciples of the Lowangen School of Transformation study healing magic and transmutation. They are members of the Great Gray Guild of the Mind and try to live according to the peaceful elvish worldview taught in the school.
The education of the gray mages of Lowangen is viewed as conventional and down-to-earth, and as such, they enjoy good reputations in the world of magic and have the respect of all the guilds

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/dc467ed326d0aa652a9a895b9d053a7dddf1d415.png[/img]
[h2]Knight[/h2]
Knights enjoy great respect in many provinces of the Middenrealm as well as in Bornland and the warring kingdoms of Nostria and Andergast. 
Some people view the knightly ways of combat as antiquated; nevertheless, they are formidable opponents.
Knights learn the art of fighting as squires in service to older knights. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/145705dd2555f152b3af7e3d7aaa7ace6af22331.png[/img]
[h2]Mercenary[/h2]
Mercenaries fight for whoever pays the most. They are often viewed as disreputable, since they seemingly follow no rules. Many have bad reputations as corrupt sell-swords.
Mercenaries and other soldiers are trained in the use of different weapons, depending on the type of unit to which they belong. 
Skirmishers wear only light armor and use
swords, hatchets, or maces, whereas some units of heavy infantry use two-handed
weapons (indeed, the famed troops known as Andergasters derive their name from a
type of two-handed sword). Archers normally provide support for the close-combat
fighters in their units, but nevertheless occasionally join the melee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/016a4da9cecd0ee5f1109b4dc4e1c8d1ac1a1631.png[/img]
[h2]Rogue[/h2]
Rogues are the kings of crime. They are at once thief, burglar, charmer, and rake. The city’s alleys are their home and nobody knows their neighborhoods better than rogues.
While a rogue’s source of income is not always obvious, it is easy to see how cat burglars earn their living. These second-story people seek the strongboxes and valuables of the wealthy and break into their homes with ease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/02e445d69c5b5aebe03c600fd88bdfd85029541b.png[/img]
[h2]White mage[/h2]
The white mages are known as excellent battlemages who protect themselves with sword and staff. They are staunch defenders of the Middenrealm and selflessly join the Empress’ army in times of war. 
Their education is tough, stern, and austere. 
The mages of Gareth are said to love truth and avoid deceptions, viewing falsehoods as displeasing to the gods.
Unlike other mages, they do not enjoy research (being magical warriors), and try to stick to the basics. Their book collections are usually smaller than those of other mages and include mostly works about their specialty: combat.

notes.title: Release date and pricing announced
notes.content:
[h2]Sharpen your swords, shine your armor, load your pack with dungeon rations, and get ready for adventure![/h2]

We are very happy to announce a [b]June 9, 2020[/b] release date for our PC action-RPG The Dark Eye: Book of Heroes.

The game will be available on Steam for [b]29.99 EUR.[/b]

Book of Heroes is based on the massively popular tabletop RPG The Dark Eye, which is one of the most beloved pen-and-paper RPGs in Germany – right up there with Dungeons and Dragons!
 
The game has you rolling up a character, creating their backstory, and heading off in search of action and
adventure in the mystical lands of Aventuria. Will you find fame and fortune, or foolhardy folly?
The choice is yours!

notes.title: Pick your profession - part 1
notes.content:
When playing The Dark Eye: Book of Heroes you have a choice of 12 different professions – here is your chance to get to know a bit more about playing Assassin, Black mage, Blessed One of Boron, Blessed Ones of Phex or Blessed Ones of Rondra.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/3c2ec440fc23142cadf27c0888221eca235812d1.png[/img]
[h2]Assassin[/h2]
Assassins are agents specially trained to kill. They are more interested in dispatching unwanted persons than in collecting information, and use weapons, poison, and intrigue to
achieve their objectives.
Nevertheless, investigation is a large part of their work, because they need to gather as much information as possible about their intended victims.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/398b39637ef64b834b3bc878c55b15dc7abd9fbc.png[/img]
[h2]Black mage[/h2]
The association called the Brotherhood of the Knowing has a reputation as ruthless black magicians. One of the centers of the guild is the Al’Achami of Fasar, a school of mindmages that is mentioned in old Tulamydian writings and shrouded in many mysteries. 
It is said that graduates must enter into a contract–written in their own blood–with the leader of the academy, and that many blasphemous experiments take place in its dark cellars. 
Some of these rumors are no doubt exaggerated, but the mages of Fasar consider themselves the magical elite on the continent and often come across as arrogant. They believe that mages are superior to all others and should use their powers to pursue their goals ruthlessly. Fasar mages refer to themselves as controllers.
This does not mean that every mage from Fasar is a villain, for they also value
good friends and may act in a way that is pleasing to the gods. It is true they
might choose methods others would deem unacceptable, but do not assume that
all are corrupt just because they train at a school of black magic


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/4f33197bf3367f1de01e4b15df0094fa2476dfb0.png[/img]
[h2]Blessed One of Boron[/h2]
At first glance, only a few aspects of Boron, the god of death, sleep, and oblivion, seem to be of interest to humans. But in Al’Anfa and other cities of southern Aventuria, Boron is the most important god. His Blessed Ones are well-respected and held in high esteem.
The Boroni are skilled exorcists and make invaluable allies against the undead. They also give comfort to the dying and bereaved and help ease their pain. Additionally, they grant people oblivion (a good night’s sleep, free from troubling memories, or even a peaceful and painless death) in the name of Boron, which often proves to be a valuable gift. 
The two regional factions of Boron’s church, one based in Al’Anfa and one in Punin, are
sworn enemies and view each other as heretical.
There are two main sects among the Blessed of Boron— the Servants of Golgari, who focus on burying the dead and tending graves, and the Servants of Bishdariel, who study the interpretation of dreams.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/231d45adb4c208ec5e781a0036e323d252bf8f72.png[/img]
[h2]Blessed Ones of Phex[/h2]
When people think of servants of the god of thieves, they imagine cutpurses or burglars. And even though some Blessed Ones of Phex also happen to be thieves who meet in hidden temples, most commit to the god’s aspect of trade, ensuring that contracts are observed and overseeing the exchange of goods between long-distance traders and guilds.
Merchants supervise the public temples of Phex and provide assistance to travelers and businesspeople. Cutpurses, probably the most well-known, are typical rogues who always seek opportunities to enrich both themselves and Phex. Burglars also seek enrichment opportunities, mainly in the form of breaking and entering, followed by looting.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35676135/d693ac4ed4cd5d6735d191f9ec0eb320477e3728.jpg[/img]
[h2]Blessed Ones of Rondra[/h2]
Whenever dark powers face humans followers of the Twelvegods in battle, you will always find the Blessed Ones of Rondra at the front line. They deem it their most important task to protect believers and thus constantly train in the arts of war and weaponry.
Rondra’s Church has three main sects:
Honors believe that honor is a gift, and that people either receive this gift at birth or they don’t. They disapprove of using magic, withdrawing from combat, and other acts which, in their view, stain their honor.
Traditionalists are not quite as orthodox as Honors, but they strongly adhere to Church customs and only rarely deviate from them. They are the largest sect in the Church of Rondra.
Salutists, in contrast to the other two sects, believe that there can be honor in a mage, a tailor, or a baker. Whosoever lives by Rondra’s commandments can prove their courage and gain honor, no matter their origins or social standing.
